$comment: benchday.openspec.report/1 — the canonical OpenSpec project report payload.

cli_available.description: a compatible openspec CLI produced structured output this evaluation

changes.description: bounded per-change state; task counts, not artifact bodies

validation_ok.description: result of the most recent validate action, when one has run

active_change.description: the change this pane is working on, ONLY when its cwd is genuinely inside openspec/changes/<name>; null otherwise (never inferred from sharing a repo)

active_change_completed.description: tasks completed in `active_change`; null when no change is associated

active_change_total.description: total tasks in `active_change`; null when no change is associated
